profile.name: Liu Liu
profile.title: Researcher
profile.bio: I am a researcher at Horizon Robotics, focusing on 3D Vision and Embodied AI. I contribute to our open-source Robot Lab ecosystem through project pages, code releases, and training stacks for embodied intelligence, with recent work spanning 3D reconstruction, generative world modeling, and robot policy transfer.

open_source.title: EmbodiedGen
open_source.description: A generative 3D world engine for embodied intelligence, with project page, paper, and open-source code.

open_source.title: FSR-VLN
open_source.description: Fast and slow reasoning for vision-language navigation with hierarchical multi-modal scene graphs.

news.content: Three papers accepted to CVPR 2026: Uni3R (highlight), 3D-Fixer, and RoboTransfer.
EmbodiedGen and RoboTransfer project pages and repositories went live in the Robot Lab ecosystem.
